title: W02d: invocation context and source-path resolution helpers
description: Build the immutable InvocationContext used by every core-facing wrapper: the canonical ledger location from explicit root, then WAYSTATION_ROOT, then upward discovery, unchanged; the caller directory or worktree when available; and the optional adapter binding identity. Resolve the evidence repository explicitly against the caller, otherwise the caller's Git repository. Neither an evidence path nor a Monitor selection may change the ledger, and neither registered projects nor the ledger may be scanned to guess a destination or source. A non-Git ledger is valid when an explicit Git evidence source is available. Never mutate process.cwd or process-global environment for one call.
acceptance: A caller, an explicit evidence source and the ledger resolve independently, and changing the evidence path never changes the ledger or the reverse.
Relative evidence paths resolve against the caller, and a non-Git ledger with an explicit source is accepted.
process.cwd and the process environment are provably unchanged across a call that supplies a different caller directory.
Resolution failures carry the existing coded diagnostics and never fall back to the caller directory.
notes: src/core/paths.ts owns resolution today. The claim path already accepts a caller override, so extend that contract instead of adding a parallel one.
